<|endoftext|>Laparoscopic appendectomy for Wilson's disease and yucca necrosis: case report and review of the literature.
A case of a 48-year-old man with Wilson's disease is reported. The diagnosis was made by transperitoneal and transhepatic biopsy of a large kidney cyst. His euvolemic status was determined to be stage 3A. Appropriate wounds were completed with a laparoscopic appendectomy. He received a subsequent course of intravenous and oral Levazopristone.
